title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 56
paragraphs: These are the royal rights that the Spartans have given their kings: two priesthoods, of Zeus Lacedaemon and Zeus Uranios; the right to make war against whatever land they choose, and that no Spartan shall hinder this right—or, if he does, he shall be subject to the curse; that on campaigns the kings shall go out first and return last; that a hundred picked men shall be their guard on expeditions; and that they shall use in their marches to war as many cattle as they wish, and take both the hides and the chine-portions of all that are sacrificed.
